skipped_reason.description: Why nothing was indexed; absent when chunks were stored. mime_not_allowed: the content is not UTF-8 text, contains a NUL byte, or its type is not in embeddings.policy.mime_allowlist. too_large: larger than embeddings.policy.max_bytes. already_indexed: the CID has index entries and force was false. not_a_file: the CID is a UnixFS directory or another non-file node. empty: the file is empty or only whitespace, so there is no chunk to embed. chunks_indexed is 0 whenever skipped_reason is present.
